description.ja: ガンダムジェミナス０２の“陸戦重装ユニット”装着形態を再現可能な拡張パーツのセットが完全新規造形で商品化。
description.en: A set of expansion parts that can reproduce the mounting form of Gundam Geminus 02's "Land Combat Heavy Equipment Unit" has been commercialized with a completely new model.

description.ja: オリジナルメカデザイナー阿久津氏監修のもと増加装甲や大型火器類を忠実に立体化。
description.en: Under the supervision of original mechanical designer Akutsu, the increased armor and large firearms have been faithfully three-dimensionalized.

description.ja: 〈 セット内容 〉
description.en: 〈Set contents〉

description.ja: ●　陸戦重装ユニット　一式
description.en: ● Complete set of heavy ground combat units

description.ja: ＜陸戦重装ユニット装着形態を再現可能！＞
description.en: <Can reproduce the mounting form of land combat heavy equipment units! ＞

description.ja: ガンダムジェミナス０２に取り付ける頭部、肩部、フロント・リアスカート、レッグユニット、
description.en: Head, shoulders, front and rear skirts, leg unit, attached to Gundam Geminus 02,

description.ja: バックパック等の各種ユニットパーツが付属し、陸戦重装ユニット装着形態を再現可能。
description.en: Various unit parts such as backpacks are included, and it is possible to reproduce the mounting form of ground combat heavy equipment units.

description.ja: ◆◆　各所機体形状／増加装甲
description.en: ◆◆ Various parts of the aircraft shape/increased armor

description.ja: 頭部アンテナ
description.en: head antenna

description.ja: 特徴的な頭部アンテナ及び後頭部を新規パーツで再現。
description.en: The characteristic head antenna and back of the head are reproduced with new parts.

description.ja: フロント／リアスカート
description.en: front/rear skirt

description.ja: 大型の腰部増加装甲ユニットを立体化。
description.en: A large lumbar increased armor unit is made into a three-dimensional figure.

description.ja: リアスカートは左右独立で可動し、ポージングを妨げない構造を採用。
description.en: The rear skirt can be moved independently on the left and right sides, and has a structure that does not interfere with posing.

description.ja: バックパック
description.en: backpack

description.ja: 各種武装を保持するアームが接続されたバックパックを再現。
description.en: Reproduces a backpack with an attached arm that holds various weapons.

description.ja: レッグユニット
description.en: leg unit

description.ja: 脹脛部分を覆うような構造で装着された、脚部装甲パーツを再現。
description.en: Reproduce the leg armor parts that are attached with a structure that covers the calf part.

description.ja: ◆◆　砲撃戦能力特化の大型火器
description.en: ◆◆ Large firearm specialized in artillery combat capability

description.ja: 砲撃戦能力に特化した陸戦重装ユニットの大型火器類を初立体化。
description.en: The first three-dimensional version of the large firearms of a heavy ground unit specializing in artillery combat capabilities.

description.ja: 各種武装は後部バックパックに接続されたアームで可動する。
description.en: Various weapons are movable with arms connected to the rear backpack.

description.ja: ビームキャノン
description.en: beam cannon

description.ja: 長大なビームキャノンはアームにより前方へ構えることができる。
description.en: The long beam cannon can be held forward using the arm.

description.ja: さらにグリップ部は回転可動ギミックを有し、様々なポージングが可能。
description.en: Furthermore, the grip part has a rotating gimmick that allows for various poses.

description.ja: シールド
description.en: Seal de

description.ja: 左肩部のシールドを再現。
description.en: Reproduce the seal on the left shoulder.

description.ja: 接続部は可動範囲の広いボールジョイントを採用。
description.en: The connection part uses a ball joint with a wide range of movement.

description.ja: ３連ミサイルランチャー
description.en: triple missile launcher

description.ja: 右肩部の３連ミサイルランチャーは計６か所の展開ギミックを搭載。ガンプラオリジナルギミックとして腕部に装着可能。
description.en: The triple missile launcher on the right shoulder has a total of 6 deployment gimmicks. Can be attached to the arm as a Gunpla original gimmick.

description.ja: ハッチの内部には２種のミサイルパーツが付属
description.en: Two types of missile parts are included inside the hatch.
